using UnityEngine;

namespace @NAMESPACE@
{
    public partial class @CLASS@
    {
        // [Trailmap: 330-resistance] Project-neutral tuning; not a retail character's statistics.
        [Range(0f, 1f)] public float resistanceLinearStat = 0.5f;
        [Range(0f, 1f)] public float resistanceQuadraticStat = 0.5f;
        [Range(0f, 1f)] public float resistanceSkidStat = 0.5f;
        [Range(0f, 1f)] public float resistanceLateralStat = 0.5f;
        public int resistanceMode = 1;
        public int resistanceEdge;
        public int resistancePreferredEdge;
        public float resistanceLoadRatio = 1f;
        public float resistanceSkid;

        float RideResponseStance()
        {
            if (resistanceEdge == resistancePreferredEdge || resistanceMode == 1) return 1f;
            return resistanceMode == 0 ? 0.8499836326f : 0.6998783350f;
        }

        // [Trailmap: 330-resistance] Velocities, lengths and output acceleration use metres.
        float RideForwardResistance(int row, float u, float error, float budget, float charge, float boost)
        {
            float stance = RideResponseStance();
            float rA = (resistanceMode == 2 ? 0.7076424360f - 0.3019791245f * resistanceLinearStat
                : 1.0649821758f - 0.3084552288f * resistanceLinearStat) * stance;
            float rC = (1.2848105431f - 0.2903534174f * resistanceQuadraticStat) * stance;
            float rS = (0.6150994897f + 0.9181777835f * resistanceSkidStat) * stance;
            float q = Mathf.Max(1f, resistanceLoadRatio);
            float x = Mathf.Abs(u) * 0.1f;
            float depth = row == 3 || row == 4 ? 0.5f - error / Mathf.Max(budget, 1e-6f) : 1f;
            return -u * depth * (q * _rideSurfResistanceA[row] * rA + (1f - charge) * 0.1057286412f
                + (1f + boost * 1.2153687477f) * 1.7513076067f * resistanceSkid * resistanceSkid * rS
                + x * (q * _rideSurfResistanceB[row] + x * q * _rideSurfResistanceC[row] * rC));
        }

        float RideLateralSpeedGain(float u)
        {
            float speed = Mathf.Abs(u);
            if (speed < 5.555555419922f) return 0.2010370344f + speed * 0.08899726090f;
            if (speed < 13.888887939453f) return 0.6954662800f + (speed - 5.555555419922f) * 0.03612979490f;
            return 0.9965478778f - (speed - 13.888887939453f) * 0.01044131714f;
        }

        // [Trailmap: 330-lateral] Acceleration; the ground integrator owns the single timestep multiplication.
        float RideLateralResistance(int row, float u, float w, float lean, float boost)
        {
            float rider = (0.0010000000475f + 1.1412174702f * resistanceLateralStat) * RideResponseStance();
            float boostGain = boost > 0f ? 1f / (1f + 3.4999945164f * boost) : 1f;
            return -w * _rideSurfDrag[row] * RideLateralSpeedGain(u)
                * Mathf.Max(1f, Mathf.Abs(lean) * 1.0001484156f) * rider * boostGain;
        }

        float RideHeadingLead(float lean, float charge)
        {
            float c0 = resistanceMode == 2 ? 0.2083389610f : resistanceMode == 0 ? 0.3001891971f : 0.4000000060f;
            float c7 = resistanceMode == 2 ? 0.2622103095f : resistanceMode == 0 ? 0.3491855264f : 0.5239824057f;
            return lean * c7 * (1f + 0.5f * c0 * (1f - lean * lean)) / (1f + charge * 0.01f);
        }

        // [Trailmap: 330-yaw] Radians per fixed tick, with full speed and signed contact projections in m/s.
        float RideHeadingYaw(float lean, float lead, float slipProjection, float speed,
            float forwardSpeed, float fallLineSpeed, float dt)
        {
            if (speed < 1e-6f || dt <= 0f) return 0f;
            float candidate = lead - Mathf.Asin(Mathf.Clamp(slipProjection, -0.99999f, 0.99999f));
            if (forwardSpeed < 0f) candidate = -candidate;
            float gate = Mathf.Min(1f, speed * speed * 0.2002984729f * dt);
            float align = Mathf.Min(1f, Mathf.Max(0f, 40f * Mathf.Min(1f, speed / 5.555555419922f)
                * (0.5f - Mathf.Abs(fallLineSpeed) / speed)) + 0.01004204992f);
            float gain = Mathf.Max(candidate > 0f ? lean : -lean, align);
            return Mathf.Clamp(candidate * gate * gain, -0.1047197580f, 0.1047197580f);
        }

        float RideBankedNormalResponse(float response, float cappedResponse, float theta)
        {
            return response + cappedResponse - cappedResponse / Mathf.Cos(theta);
        }
    }
